# Proquoment Labs

> Proquoment Labs is an AI-native Product & Engineering Studio. We help ambitious startups build AI-powered products and help businesses prepare for an AI-powered future through intelligent software, automation, and modern engineering.

## Core Pillars & Capabilities
- AI SaaS & Digital Product Engineering: Turning product ideas into production-ready digital platforms, SaaS MVPs, custom dashboards, streaming APIs, and full-stack applications.
- Business Process Automation & Integrations: Connecting systems, workflow orchestration, CRM/ERP integrations, automated document extraction, and event-driven automation.
- Web Applications & Digital Experiences: Designing and engineering modern websites, web applications, customer portals, interactive dashboards, and responsive digital interfaces.

## Canonical Public Pages
- [Home](https://labs.proquoment.in/): Overview of Proquoment Labs AI product engineering, automation, and digital experiences.
- [Services](https://labs.proquoment.in/services): Deep dive into AI SaaS engineering, business process automation, and web application development.
- [Work](https://labs.proquoment.in/work): Production case studies including autonomous agent swarms, SaaS MVP sprints, and workflow automation.
- [About](https://labs.proquoment.in/about): The dedicated AI engineering and innovation studio of Proquoment Private Limited.
- [Contact](https://labs.proquoment.in/contact): Start an AI project with direct engineering review and <24h response SLA.
- [Insights & Industry AI Dispatches](https://labs.proquoment.in/blog): Deep-dive case studies, playbooks, and architectures for enterprise AI implementation.
- [Privacy Policy](https://labs.proquoment.in/privacy-policy): Privacy and data governance policy compliant with IT and DPDP Acts.
- [Terms of Service](https://labs.proquoment.in/terms-of-service): Commercial terms and intellectual property ownership standards.
